declarations.type_text:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (f : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n → ℝ) (L η β : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    0 ≤ η →
      0 ≤ β →
        β < 1 →
          (∀ (W W' : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n), ‖gradient f W - gradient f W'‖ ≤ L * ‖W - W'‖) →
            ∀ (W M G D : ℕ → OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n),
              (∀ (t : ℕ), W (t + 1) = W t - η • OracleTemplate.Muon.orthogonalize (M t)) →
                M 0 = G 0 →
                  (∀ (t : ℕ), M (t + 1) = β • M t + (1 - β) • G (t + 1)) →
                    D 0 = G 0 - gradient f (W 0) →
                      (∀ (t : ℕ), D (t + 1) = β • D t + (1 - β) • (G (t + 1) - gradient f (W (t + 1)))) →
                        ∀ (t : ℕ), ‖gradient f (W t) - M t‖ ≤ ‖D t‖ + √↑(min m n) * β * L * η / (1 - β)

∀ {m n : ℕ} (f : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n → ℝ) (Ls η β : ℝ),
  0 ≤ Ls →
    0 ≤ η →
      0 ≤ β →
        β < 1 →
          (∀ (W W' : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n),
              OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm (gradient f W - gradient f W') ≤
                Ls * OracleTemplate.Muon.spectralNorm (W - W')) →
            ∀ (W M G D : ℕ → OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n),
              (∀ (t : ℕ), W (t + 1) = W t - η • OracleTemplate.Muon.orthogonalize (M t)) →
                M 0 = G 0 →
                  (∀ (t : ℕ), M (t + 1) = β • M t + (1 - β) • G (t + 1)) →
                    D 0 = G 0 - gradient f (W 0) →
                      (∀ (t : ℕ), D (t + 1) = β • D t + (1 - β) • (G (t + 1) - gradient f (W (t + 1)))) →
                        ∀ (t : ℕ),
                          OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm (gradient f (W t) - M t) ≤
                            √↑(min m n) * ‖D t‖ + β * Ls * η / (1 - β)

∀ {m n : ℕ} (f : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n → ℝ) (Ls : ℝ),
  (∀ (W : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n), HasGradientAt f (gradient f W) W) →
    (∀ (W W' : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n),
        OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm (gradient f W - gradient f W') ≤
          Ls * OracleTemplate.Muon.spectralNorm (W - W')) →
      ∀ (W D : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n),
        f (W + D) ≤ f W + inner ℝ (gradient f W) D + Ls * OracleTemplate.Muon.spectralNorm D ^ 2 / 2

declarations.type_text:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (f : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n → ℝ) (L η : ℝ),
  0 < η →
    0 ≤ L →
      (∀ (W : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n), HasGradientAt f (gradient f W) W) →
        (∀ (W W' : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n), ‖gradient f W - gradient f W'‖ ≤ L * ‖W - W'‖) →
          ∀ (W M : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n),
            η * OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm (gradient f W) ≤
              f W - f (W - η • OracleTemplate.Muon.orthogonalize M) + ↑(min m n) * L * η ^ 2 / 2 +
                2 * η * √↑(min m n) * ‖gradient f W - M‖

∀ {m n : ℕ} (f : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n → ℝ) (Ls η : ℝ),
  0 < η →
    0 ≤ Ls →
      (∀ (W : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n), HasGradientAt f (gradient f W) W) →
        (∀ (W W' : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n),
            OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm (gradient f W - gradient f W') ≤
              Ls * OracleTemplate.Muon.spectralNorm (W - W')) →
          ∀ (W M : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n),
            η * OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm (gradient f W) ≤
              f W - f (W - η • OracleTemplate.Muon.orthogonalize M) + Ls * η ^ 2 / 2 +
                2 * η * OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm (gradient f W - M)
